design-tokens.upstream_concepts: DESIGN.md format (YAML token front matter + Markdown rationale), 9 lint rules (broken-ref, contrast-ratio WCAG AA, section-order, orphaned-tokens, …), diff regressions, export to Tailwind v3/v4 + W3C DTCG
design-tokens.description: Clean-room wrapper skill (ADR-0002 Phase C) — NO Apache code or text vendored; all prose original. Teaches the DESIGN.md format and wraps the @google/design.md CLI via npx (lint/diff/export/spec), exactly as agentshield-scan wraps ecc-agentshield. Reference-not-vendor: the tool runs via npx, nothing is canonicalized. Intended as the shared, lintable token contract the frontend cluster (clone-website, frontend-design, design-taste-frontend) can converge on — handoffs are manual, not automatic wiring.

decision-mockups.description: VENDORED MIRROR, not the canon. The skill's home — with its own test suite and the deterministic G0-G14 page gate (references/check_page.py) — is @dzhechkov/skills-decision-mockups; this copy exists so the `meta` preset can keep its promise for anyone who installs only @dzhechkov/skills-meta. Same pattern as goap-research-ed25519 in @dzhechkov/skills-news. HEAL DIRECTION MATTERS: sync with `dz sync-canonical decision-mockups --from packages/@dzhechkov/skills-decision-mockups/decision-mockups`; a bare `dz sync-canonical decision-mockups` resolves the canonical to skills-meta/ and would overwrite the real home from this mirror.
